newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa would pay up to 181 bln ptas for Retevision.
newsitem.headline: Endesa would pay up to 181 bln ptas for Retevision.

text.p: The consortium led by Spanish utility Endesa and Italian telecommunications group Stet would have to pay up to 181 billion pesetas if its bid for 60 percent of Retevision is accepted, a spokesman for Spain's second telephone operator said.

"Endesa and Stet have offered 48,483 pesetas a share, which represents 116.36 billion pesetas for the initial 60 percent of Retevision, but with the subsequent expansion, this amount rises by 64.64 billion pesetas to 181 billion," the Retevision spokesman said.

The privatisation plan foresees the sale of 60 percent of state-owned Retevision, but together with this operation, the bid winner must also underwrite a capital rise of 10 percent to bring its final stake to 70 percent.

Nonetheless, the representative of Endesa in the consortium, Luis Rodriguez Salmero, emphasised that while the first 116 billion pesetas went to the state, the remaining funds stay within the group to reinforce Retevision's capital. --Madrid Newsroom +34 1 585 2167
